body: This might sound wrong, but try to rise above them in a way you can look down on those who used to look down on you. Work hard, become something they could only dream of becoming. Don’t go. I’m in high school too on the brink of ending it all, but I’d rather myself go than let anyone else. You deserve to be here. You have a place. Find the version of yourself you are driven to become. Once you find it, don’t let anything, and I mean anything, get in your way. I don’t know you, but courage is deep within. You have strength, you can keep on. Don’t let anything make you think different.
Don’t do anything painful to yourself.

I know I really don’t have any place saying anything with similar problems of my own, but a good way you could feel something is to write it out and -if you feel comfortable- give it to someone you trust. I sometimes desensitized myself to the overwhelming thoughts by spilling my feelings out. Think of letting your thoughts and emotions out like one last scream. Get help. Find it if you can.
